items.text: Good school nutrition is vital for children’s growth & development. Thank you to Lisa Seiber-Garland, Vickie Dunaway, & their families from West TN for discussing w/ me how the rising cost of goods impacts their work and how we can work together to ensure no child is left unfed. https://t.co/9XsrQ1ZTNZ

This morning, I met with @AADskin to discuss removing barriers to outpatient treatment to ensure patients have access to good-quality, affordable health care.
 
Thank you to Dr. John Pierce of Madison County, & Dr. Angie Wan & Dr. George Woodbury of Shelby County for stopping by. https://t.co/63K9raiUB5

Today, I traveled to Madison County to speak with @WTHealthcare President and CEO JR Ross, COO Tina Prescott, State @SenEdJackson, and other hospital officials. 

Thank you for working hard to ensure the health and well-being of patients in our communities! https://t.co/GsoeR27mFi

I was happy to tour Crestwyn Behavioral Health, part of Acadia Healthcare, in Shelby County today. 

Thank you to CEO Lindsey Blevins and CFO Hunter Ross, for showing me around and telling me how you provide mental healthcare services to patients in our community. https://t.co/uy2W43GiZ0

I am very concerned with what appears to be weaponization of the DOJ. No one is above the law, that includes President Trump, President Biden, Hunter Biden & Hillary Clinton. President Trump deserves equal treatment. I encourage the DOJ to release the details of the indictment.

The whistleblower testimony regarding the treatment of Hunter Biden at the IRS and DOJ is deeply disturbing.
 
As a former U.S. Attorney, I am committed to demanding answers into what appears to be a two-tiered system of justice. 

https://t.co/DeMz30q0MG

Thank you to Clinical Coordinator Ethan Mullis at the @DaVita Dialysis Center for allowing me to tour today. I appreciate all you do to care for patients in McNairy County and West Tennessee. https://t.co/2svzxqKQmq

Great to tour @encompasshlth’s West Tennessee Healthcare Rehabilitation Hospital Jackson today with CEO Julie Taylor and Senior VP Justin Hunter. Thank you for showing me how you care for patients in Madison County. https://t.co/WzZh3iIgGl

I am honored to be named a Champion of Healthcare Innovation by @HealthInFocus today. 

Together, we can find innovative ways to care for patients across the country. https://t.co/w9gWaw4TtT

It was great to visit with Brad Cannon, President of Global Orthopedics at @SmithNephewPLC, today in Washington. 

Thank you for being a valued employer in Shelby County and for working to create innovative devices that help improve the health and wellbeing of all patients. https://t.co/d9CkenW12V

It was great to meet with @LifespanHealth COO Matt McGinley this morning to discuss ways to further support rural healthcare. Thank you for meeting with me and caring for patients in Hardin County. https://t.co/grVh96zfsf

I appreciated visiting @HardinMedical to meet with CEO Jim Edmonson and County Mayor Kevin Davis. Thank you for your dedication to providing good-quality care to patients and families in West Tennessee. https://t.co/NyXk2x8Tr5

I enjoyed meeting with @EveryLifeOrg, including with Leeya Alperin from Shelby County, today. Thank you for working to raise awareness and support rare disease patients across the country. https://t.co/fqvGvpo0Qj
Please join Roberta and me in praying for Majority Leader @SteveScalise. Steve is a fighter and our thoughts will continue to be with him and his family as he begins treatment.

I appreciated meeting with @ASHPOfficial members Jennifer Robertson and Alex Rodriguez from Shelby County, as well as Simran Chahal from Madison County. Thank you for being a strong voice for pharmaceutical members and patients. https://t.co/drtPkjGCGH

Today, @WaysandMeansGOP released more documents that reveal Joe Biden’s connections to his son Hunter's business dealings, as well as what appears to be a two-tiered system of justice.

If Hunter’s last name was Smith or Jones, he would not have had the same treatment.

MORE ⬇️ https://t.co/Yqa0S7fgff

ICYMI: I joined @greta on @NEWSMAX to discuss the new documents @WaysandMeansGOP released further proving the special treatment Hunter Biden received by the DOJ. 
 
No American is above the law. 
 
WATCH: https://t.co/utdrbEvmEa

NEWS: I introduced legislation with @RepSchneider to revoke tax-exempt status to nonprofits supporting Hamas. Under no circumstances, should organizations supporting terrorism be allowed to receive preferential treatment under the U.S. tax code

More 👇
https://t.co/3TkIH2sPKm

By initiating a formal impeachment inquiry into President Joe Biden's alleged involvement in his family's business dealings, the House of Representatives will exercise its constitutional authority to issue subpoenas and utilize additional investigatory tools to probe any misconduct. I voted to open this inquiry so that House Republicans can continue to get the facts on behalf of the American people.

Yesterday, I visited Dr. Mark Dearth at his pharmacy in Chester County.

For years, the Henderson Family Pharmacy has ensured patients have access to the medication they need. Thank you for playing an important role in West Tennessee's healthcare system. https://t.co/BYVdeLLH9e

Today, I visited @IVXHealth in Shelby County to meet with Senior VP of Strategy & Product Katie Thackston, Senior VP of Operations Carsten Bick, and Memphis Regional Operations Director Sherry Whitten. Thank you for offering quality health care to patients across West TN. https://t.co/QlWTvWzkqP

It was great to meet with Master Medical Equipment Owners Mark and Jill Taylor in Madison County today. Thank you for ensuring healthcare organizations have the innovative, high-quality products they need to care for patients. https://t.co/hRYCy8kmsi

Under no circumstances should organizations supporting terrorism be allowed to receive preferential treatment under the U.S. tax code.

It is imperative that Congress pass my legislation to revoke the tax-exempt status of any organization that provides support to terrorist organizations, such as Hamas.

The NCAA's unchecked authority and lack of transparency have led to unfair treatment within college athletics, most recently at the University of Tennessee. I applaud @AGTennessee Jonathan Skrmetti for taking swift action to protect Tennessee’s student-athletes. It is time to pass my legislation, the NCAA Accountability Act, to ensure due process, fairness, and accountability in NCAA enforcement proceedings. Student-athletes and universities deserve clear and fair rules.

Thank you to @alzassociation Advocate, Amy Elder from Lauderdale County for meeting with me. I appreciated hearing about how we can best aid Alzheimer’s research, as well as help patients and their families in West Tennessee. https://t.co/4Zlqqwv5xv
